subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `outputSchema` become the supported optional plugin API for both model-visible result hints and runtime validation of final `AgentToolResult.details` values?
rationale: This adds a permanent external plugin contract and intentionally makes opted-in result mismatches fail after hooks, so implementation correctness alone cannot decide the compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after projection fix
options.body: Approve the single optional API and its documented validation semantics after rejected results are prevented from entering transcript projections.

options.title: Limit to hints only
options.body: Expose declared schemas as bounded Code Mode and Tool Search hints without enforcing runtime result validation until the compatibility contract is separately designed.

options.title: Defer the API
options.body: Keep results unknown and raw-first until maintainers want to support a stable structured tool-result contract across all runtimes.

recommendation.title: Approve after projection fix
recommendation.body: Approve the single optional API and its documented validation semantics after rejected results are prevented from entering transcript projections.
